title: Spiritual Discipline Recommender
subtitle: One practice to try this week

questions.text: What's the truest description of your week?

options.text: Loud. I have not heard myself think.
Numb. I've been autopiloting through it.
Hungry. I want more of God and don't know where to start.
Tangled. My appetites have been running me.

questions.text: Where does your prayer life feel weakest right now?

options.text: Consistency. I pray when I feel like it, which is rare.
Depth. I'm skimming the Bible instead of feeding on it.
Honesty. I'm performing more than I'm processing.
Stillness. I can't get quiet enough to hear Him.

questions.text: Pick the rhythm that's been broken in you lately:

options.text: Rest. I haven't truly stopped in months.
Reflection. I move so fast I never review what God did.
Generosity. My hands have closed without me noticing.
Discipline. My body has been calling the shots.

questions.text: If God could give you one thing this week, you'd want...

options.text: His voice, clear and unmistakable, on the thing I'm asking about.
His peace. I haven't stopped long enough to receive it.
His breakthrough. I need Him to move on something stuck.
His perspective. I want to see my life the way He sees it.
"I have not read the Bible slowly in a long time."
"I have not given to someone who can't pay me back recently."
"I have not taken a full day off in weeks."
"I have not journaled what I actually feel in months."

questions.text: What does your phone usage look like?

options.text: Constant. I check it before I check in with God.
Numbing. I scroll to avoid feeling things.
Distracting. I can't sit still for an hour without it.
Driving me. I follow my urges, not my values.

questions.text: Pick the line that names where you actually are:

options.text: I'm spiritually full but socially closed. I need to give.
I'm running on prayers I prayed years ago. I need fresh hearing.
I'm overstimulated. I need silence more than I need answers.
I'm out of touch with my own heart. I need to write it out.

questions.text: If you imagined your best self a year from now, what would she/he be doing differently?

options.text: Resting deeply, working from rest instead of toward it.
Praying at set times like the day depends on it, because it does.
Saying no to appetites that used to run them.
Giving more than they keep, and not telling anyone.

lectio-divina.name: Try Lectio Divina This Week
lectio-divina.description: Set aside 15 minutes tomorrow morning. Read John 1:1-5 four times, slowly, with pauses. Write down the one word that catches you, sit with it for five minutes, then thank God for showing you why it landed. Do that for five mornings in a row and watch what He does with the rest of your day.

fasting.name: Try Fasting This Week
fasting.description: Pick one meal this week to skip, and use that hour to pray instead. When the hunger pings, let it remind you to ask God for the breakthrough you've been carrying. Fasting isn't earning anything. It clears the static so His voice gets louder than your appetites.

silence.name: Try Silence This Week
silence.description: Find twenty minutes, leave your phone in another room, and just sit with God. No music, no podcast, no prayer list. It will feel uncomfortable for the first twelve minutes. Stay. The last eight are where He usually shows up.

journaling.name: Try Journaling This Week
journaling.description: Open a notebook five mornings this week. Write the date, write what you actually feel, then write one prayer in your own words. Don't edit. Don't perform. By Friday you'll have a record of God meeting you in your honesty, and your heart will feel less tangled.

sabbath.name: Try Sabbath This Week
sabbath.description: Pick a 24-hour window, Saturday evening to Sunday evening if you can. No work email, no errands, no productivity. Sleep in, eat slowly, worship, walk, nap, gather with people you love. Your soul has been waiting for you to stop.

fixed-hour-prayer.name: Try Fixed-Hour Prayer This Week
fixed-hour-prayer.description: Set three phone alarms, 8 a.m., noon, and 6 p.m., and pray the Lord's Prayer slowly at each one. Two minutes, three times a day. By the end of the week your day will be threaded through with God instead of fitting Him into the cracks.

examen.name: Try the Daily Examen This Week
examen.description: Five minutes before bed every night. Ask two questions: "Where did I feel close to God today?" and "Where did I feel far from Him?" Write down one sentence for each. Within a week you'll see patterns you've been blind to, and God will start adjusting your life through them.

almsgiving.name: Try Almsgiving This Week
almsgiving.description: Pick one person God puts on your mind. Not a charity, a person. Give them something they can't pay back. Cover their meal, fill their gas tank, slide them money with no note. Don't tell anyone. Watch what happens to your heart by Friday.
